About Test Yourself: Listening

An adaptive listening check: how well the learner understands spoken letters, words, sentences, times, greetings and instructions. It draws on the listening gap-fill games, Listen and Unscramble, the Speaking Game, Greetings, Do What It Says, Letter Names, the phonics games, Digital Time, First, Second, Third and Where Is It.

How to play

  1. Answer each round.
  2. The test changes to match you.
  3. See your results.

Play it as a class

Students take it on their own phones, with headphones in a busy room.
